---
name: Share a CNC profile
about: Paste the reviewed profile copied by the app
labels: ''
---

Paste the text from C2C DNC's **Share > Copy and open GitHub** into this description, replacing these instructions. Then choose **Submit new issue**. No file attachment or pull request is needed.

Before posting, remove customer/shop names, serial numbers, private paths, programs, logs or secrets. Public issues are visible to everyone. Post only material you have rights to contribute under the project MIT License. A GitHub account is needed to submit, not to download public files.

A new profile is **Not confirmed**. You can describe what worked or add a follow-up comment, but only reviewed separate machine-test evidence can earn **Confirmed** for the stated setup and operation. Unverified starters remain in the repository download library, not bundled defaults. Your saved local profiles are not replaced.
